sn31.3:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn31.3:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 5
sn31.3:1.4: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati ||
sn31.3:1.6: Mūlagandhe adhivatthā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 6
sn31.3:1.8: Ahovatāham kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjeyyanti || ||
sn31.3:1.10: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjati || || 7
sn31.3:1.12: yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sakavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-4
